source.scope: Respuestas Borg originales durante tareas al aire libre con carga de 20 minutos. Evalúa esa tarea; falta validar caminatas y uso clínico.
source.label_definition: Original borg_scale response, retained verbatim as a class; no low/medium/high relabeling.
source.transformations: Last complete measured pulse-rate minute within two minutes before each observation; elapsed time from published task start; discard missing readings; no imputation.

temporal_policy: Use only one-minute windows ending at or before response; baseline windows end before task start and begin after prior task end. No rating/history-of-ratings predictors.
user_authorization: User explicitly allowed a previous Borg self-report during the activity.
evaluation_scope: Participant-disjoint model fitting with chronological observed Borg calibration feedback. This is not sensor-only inference.
temporal_history_policy: Only observed Borg 1-15 minutes before prediction; HR change uses the last complete observed minute ending before that prior report. No current/future target or physiology is used.
session_history_policy: Observed reports from the same session strictly at least one minute before prediction; recent mandatory report still 1-15 minutes old. Older history is optional personal scale calibration. No future/current ratings or cross-session feedback.
dynamics_policy: Same-session actual reports <= prediction minus one minute. Physiology uses completed minutes <= each prior report. No participant IDs, absolute timestamps, current/future Borg, interpolated labels or cohort exclusions.
body_identifier_normalization: Case only: original P0 corresponds to p0; uniqueness checked after normalization.
body_input_contract: Actual pre-task age (years), mass (kg), stature (cm); 9.1 kg is the observed fixed study load. No IDs or gender as predictors. Not a sensor-only model.
